steps.label: Disposal
steps.text: Used bottles placed in recycling bins

steps.label: Collection
steps.text: Collected by truck and taken to recycling plant

steps.label: Crushing & shredding
steps.text: Crushed into bales, then shredded into small flakes

steps.label: Washing
steps.text: Flakes washed to remove labels and glue

steps.label: Melting
steps.text: Clean, dry flakes melted and formed into pellets

steps.label: Manufacturing
steps.text: Made into new bottles, clothing fibres, carpets and packaging
